## Checklist

### Required

- [ ] Code compiles without errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Formatting is correct (`npm run format:check`)
- [ ] No TypeScript errors (`npx tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] I have tested this change locally

### Accessibility (required for UI changes)

- [ ] All interactive elements are keyboard-accessible
- [ ] Focus-visible styles are present on new controls
- [ ] Color contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA (≥ 4.5:1 for body text)
- [ ] New images have meaningful `alt` text
- [ ] axe-core audit passes (`npm run test:a11y`)

### Performance (required for UI changes)

- [ ] No unnecessary client-side JS added (prefer Server Components)
- [ ] Images use `next/image` with appropriate `sizes` and `priority`
- [ ] Heavy libraries are dynamically imported if not in the critical path
- [ ] Lighthouse Performance score is not degraded

### Documentation

- [ ] README updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Code comments added for non-obvious logic
- [ ] New environment variables added to `.env.example`
